description: This file is part of the Moment.js library, specifically handling date creation from arrays. It includes functions to generate Date objects from array inputs, handle week and day calculations, and parse date components with considerations for time zones and special cases like 24-hour days.

methods.name: currentDateArray(config)
methods.description: Returns an array with current year, month, and date based on local or UTC time depending on configuration.

methods.name: configFromArray(config)
methods.description: Converts a date from an array of components, handling defaults, week info, day of year, and timezone offsets to produce a Date object and update configuration accordingly.

methods.name: dayOfYearFromWeekInfo(config)
methods.description: Calculates day of year from week-based date information, updating the configuration and handling special cases for week and weekday data.
